rationale: Ground truth has no substantive concerns (just LGTM approvals), so recall is trivially satisfied by both. X offers only two adjacent-file/process findings, one of which (README gap) is arguably undercut by the fact that file's example is SDK-based, not curl-based. Y digs much deeper into the diff's own new prose, catching a concrete inaccuracy ('silent audio' vs. the traced 500-error path) and an overbroad claim about extra_body that contradicts another recipe (GLM-Image), both with precise file:line evidence and exact suggested rewrites plus a verification command. Y's findings are more numerous, better grounded in the actual diff content, and more actionable, making it the stronger review despite being longer.
